answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the spiral check. Bindings are kept in fable, verified in umber, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 1397 identities would post 1024 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
